svg.title: JDBC Caffeine Write Strategy Sequence
svg.desc: Sequence diagram rebuilt from exposed-jdbc-caffeine README, AbstractJdbcCaffeineRepository source, LocalCacheConfig, and read/write strategy tests.
svg.text: Read-through loads misses from JDBC; write-through persists in-line; write-behind queues a bounded background batch.

g.text: This sequence follows the blocking JdbcCaffeineRepository path; suspend repositories mirror the strategy with suspend DB calls.
Write-behind accepts the queue before exposing the cache update, then flushes JDBC batches in the worker.
